Install guide

Install the package with your package manager. The command is the same on macOS, Windows and Linux.

pnpm add graphock

Configuration

Create a configuration file next to your project and set the workspace directory.

{ "workspace": "./data" }

Troubleshooting

If the command is not found, check your PATH. If permissions fail, check the directory owner.
